title: Mixing: Imagine, How Do You Sleep?, How? Jealous Guy, It’s So Hard by John Lennon | 1971
content:
Studio A, Record Plant, New York City
Producer: John Lennon
Engineer: Allan Steckler

A mixing session for John Lennon’s Imagine album took place at New York’s Record Plant studio on 13 July 1971.

The album had been completed earlier in the month, but during this session engineer Allan Steckler created mixes of the strings overdubs of five songs: ‘Imagine’, ‘How Do You Sleep?’, ‘How?’, ‘Jealous Guy’, and ‘It’s So Hard’.
